verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a secrets-scanning tool with an Enterprise platform, so asking whether it can issue scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question. The pack has no evidence that it issues any API keys or tokens, let alone scoped or least-privilege ones. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Enterprise role-based access control (docs-24) controls user access, and the Analyze feature (docs-9, gh-4) inspects the permissions of leaked secrets rather than issuing credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
